entries.title: Avatar, Battle & Online Improvements
changes: 🎨 AVATAR & PROFILE IMPROVEMENTS
Added stretching controls for Hair, Masks, and Props. Selected assets now have additional resize handles in the middle of each side for horizontal and vertical stretching.
Added a Reset button to restore the selected avatar asset to its original size and proportions.
Improved avatar visibility during online matches. Clicking a player's banner now allows their avatar to be opened in a larger view.
Players using a custom avatar now have an avatar preview beside their name on the battle map.
Hovering over a player's avatar preview enlarges it for a clearer view.
Added five new free avatar faces.
Fixed the Backgrounds tab in the Avatar Shop incorrectly using the menu-closing sound.
📱 MOBILE IMPROVEMENTS
Added a View Evolutions button at the bottom of Pokémon cards on mobile.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Fixed Rough Skin incorrectly applying Cracked Markers while the Pokémon was affected by a Special Condition.
Fixed Air Balloon so it sets MP to 2 regardless of normal +MP or -MP Markers, while still respecting Ability-based MP overrides.
Fixed Tangrowth's Entangle wheel-spin animation for Pokémon located two steps away.
🌐 ONLINE & RANKED
Improved Ranked reconnection handling to reduce network desyncs, skipped synchronized actions, and stuck battle choices after reconnecting.
Fixed persistent Ability effects sometimes being lost after reconnecting to an online duel.

entries.title: New Look, New Trainers, New Vibes
changes: ✨ NEW FEATURES
Added custom avatars. Create your own look with trainers, hairstyles, masks, and backgrounds, then move, resize, and rotate assets in the Avatar Editor.
Non-exclusive masks are now available to all players through the shop and Avatar Editor.
Added rank-based trainer rewards. New trainer avatars become available for purchase as you reach higher Rank Point requirements.
🎨 UI & QUALITY OF LIFE
Refreshed the Shop, Inventory, and Team Selection screens with updated layouts and visuals.
All Team Selection modes now share the same visual design, with controls adapted for each mode.
Added saved-team search, newest-first ordering, and faster team browsing.
Random teams now remain hidden behind question marks until the match begins.
Team Builder searches now include move and Ability descriptions.
Added additional Team Builder filters for Status Conditions and movement-related effects.
Added reverse alphabetical sorting to the Shop.
Shop items now display clearer unlock requirements.
Trainer names no longer display internal variant numbers.
Masks now use descriptive names.
Improved Inventory spacing and reduced item-card sizes for easier browsing.
Adjusted oversized mask artwork in the Inventory.
Improved multi-chest opening with clearer quantity controls.
🐛 FIXES
Fixed the AI sometimes playing for the wrong side after attaching a Symbiont Marker.
Fixed opponents being able to act while Sand Veil or Sandslash choices were still pending.
Fixed Balloon Body incorrectly allowing an additional MP move after stopping beside it.
Fixed Pokémon information scrolling in the mobile Ability Library.
On mobile, tapping a Pokémon in the Move and Ability Libraries now opens its information card. Tapping outside the card closes it.
Fixed the Avatar Editor's empty Props message displaying vertically.

entries.title: Final Stretch
changes: 🎨 UI UPDATES
Updated the Team Builder UI.
⚔️ BATTLE MECHANICS & ABILITIES
Fixed Arceus incorrectly resisting Kartana's Ultra Space ability while Cracked. Arceus only prevents attack effects that send it to Ultra Space; abilities such as Kartana's can still send it there.

Fixed the interaction between Palkia UX and Kartana. Palkia UX's ability now takes priority by preventing the knockout and moving Palkia to an Entry Point instead. Palkia is only sent to Ultra Space if both Entry Points are blocked.
Pokémon with a Pumpkin Marker occupying an Entry Point can now be moved over when deploying a Pokémon from the Bench, regardless of whether the marked Pokémon belongs to you or your opponent.

Fixed Phantom Arrow so its field-spin effect activates after a Win, Loss, or Draw against White or Gold attacks. The effect now also resolves correctly against movement attacks such as Sunsteel Strike and Judgment.
Fixed Chesnaught's Spiky Shield automatically selecting where the opponent moves. The player is now given the appropriate movement options.
Fixed Shiny Glaceon's Tackle not displaying its damage. Tackle now correctly shows 40 damage.
Fixed Tractor against Pokémon that cannot be moved, such as Toxapex or Snorlax. The opposing Pokémon remains in place, but the Tractor user can still move itself.

Fixed Earthquake and similar wheel-spin effects incorrectly considering Miss segments created by Burn or Paralysis. These effects now spin the Pokémon's normal wheel without field-applied status modifications unless the move specifically states otherwise, such as Origin Pulse or Precipice Blades.
Fixed Suicune's Sheer Cold against a Frozen Arceus. Arceus remains protected from exclusion, but Sheer Cold's knockout effect now correctly sends it to the P.C.
Restored the missing Tapu Fini ability text: "On your turn, Pokémon within 2 steps of this Pokémon cannot be affected by any special condition."
Fixed Dazzling Gleam's spin effect failing to activate when affected by moves such as Sunsteel Strike, Judgment, and similar movement attacks.
Fixed Muddy Water incorrectly pushing opposing Pokémon diagonally. Pokémon can now only be pushed in a straight line.
Fixed Muddy Water failing to apply Wait when the adjacent opposing Pokémon cannot be moved because its path is blocked or it has reached the end of the line.
Fixed Primarina's ability not allowing Round to count Pokémon with the Sing attack. Round now correctly counts Pokémon with either Round or Sing.
Fixed Sharpedo EX's Washout automatically selecting where the opponent moves. The player is now given the appropriate movement options.
Restored Milotic's Blue attack option to Confuse itself, allowing it to properly interact with its ability as in the original game.
Fixed Magic Coat failing to reflect Special Conditions and Markers. It now properly reflects applicable effects from White attacks and lower-star Purple attacks.

Fixed Palkia EX being excluded when knocked out while affected by a Curse Marker. Because its ability prevents it from being knocked out, damage-based exclusion effects now fail and Palkia EX moves to the Bench instead.
Fixed restored evolved Pokémon such as Aurorus, Tyrantrum, and Omastar failing to return to their previous Evolution when excluded.
Fixed the Energy Ball Marker remaining attached after the affected Pokémon is knocked out or transformed.
Fixed Flame Sphere allowing Pokémon to move over other Pokémon while deploying from the Bench. Its movement effect now only applies while on the field.
✨ MEGA EVOLUTION
Fixed Mega Evolution becoming unlimited after a Pokémon returned from Ultra Space.

entries.title: Go on a Quest!
changes: 🎯 DAILY QUESTS & REWARDS
Added eight daily quests: four Easy, two Medium, and two Hard.
Added live quest progress during eligible duels and two free quest replacements per day.
Completed quests reward an item chest and a Gold Chest, with additional rewards at 4, 6, and 8 completed quests.
Added Claim All to collect completed quests and milestone rewards together.
Daily quests reset at 00:00 UTC. Unclaimed rewards expire at reset.
Reduced new quest progress requirements by 40%.
Updated Wheel Variety so each color can contribute once per duel.
📦 INVENTORY & CHEST OPENING
Added batch opening for 1–10 chests of the same type, including a MAX shortcut.
Added animated chest openings with rarity-colored light, sound effects, particle bursts, and individual item reveals.
Batch openings now use faster reveals and a scrollable reward display.
The opening effect reflects the highest reward rarity in the batch.
Fixed missing artwork on admin-granted chests.
⚔️ BATTLE & INTERFACE IMPROVEMENTS
Redesigned the battle screen with larger Pokémon figures and clearer wheels.
Consolidated player names, duel timers, and Z-Move gauges into the top banners.
Added a centered weather banner with hover descriptions.
Expanded move panels with scrollable effect descriptions.
Added Active Effects panels for statuses, markers, Plates, and supported field effects.
Improved status icons, Burn and Frozen visuals, wheel spacing, and repeated-hit damage text.
Refreshed board controls and added animated turn indicators.
End Turn now draws attention when no actions remain or the player has been idle.
Updated Gym Leader, Elite Four, and Champion introductions.
Restored the original Player Hub layout and refined its banner presentation.
🎮 GAMEPLAY CHANGES
Enabled Z-Moves in normal builds.
Limited repeated-hit sequences such as Fire Spin to 10 actual spins, including the initial spin. Ability bonus hits remain additional.
Restricted each figure to one Mega Evolution attachment, including alternate Mega forms.
If no figure can move, a legally usable Plate must be used before ending the turn.
Reduced Bidoof UX base MP from 3 to 2.
🐛 POKÉMON, MOVE & ABILITY FIXES
Aegislash: Blade Form now returns to Shield Form when leaving the field.
Larvesta / Volcarona: Fixed Fire Scales incorrectly burning protected attackers in range-two battles.
Range-two battles: Fixed applicable defensive knockout-prevention effects.
Eevee: Fixed evolution opportunities in certain battles where the defeated opponent changes form.
Eevee R: Fixed access to Extreme Evoboost.
Extreme Evoboost: Corrected its effect on allied Eevee-series figures.
Bright Arrow: Fixed MP protection in certain ability interactions.
Arceus: Effects that bring Arceus onto the field now correctly trigger its entry ability.
Regirock / Regice / Registeel: Their abilities now correctly affect all opposing figures within two steps.
Dialga — 4-D Drive: Fixed opponent relocation when Dialga loses the damage comparison.
Manaphy’s Song: Corrected legal movement destinations and pass-through restrictions.
Wash Away / Tidal Wave: Players can now choose the destination when multiple legal push routes are available.
Gyarados — Waterfall: Corrected Water-type interactions and landing choices.
Totodile / Croconaw — Bite Instinct: The required battle can no longer be skipped after qualifying movement.
Focus Energy / Swords Dance: Repeated results now apply a single ×2 damage modifier instead of stacking.
Celebi — Time Travel: Corrected restoration of evolutions, forms, and wheels.
Air Balloon: Corrected interactions with abilities that prevent pass-through.
Cracked: Surrounded figures now follow normal knockout rules instead of being automatically excluded.
Fixed marker cleanup during form changes while preserving Wait.
Fixed wheel status-icon errors in certain previews.
🏆 RANKED & REPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
Added Ranked AI opponents when no eligible human opponent is available.
Below 1600 rating: Ranked AI becomes available after 20 seconds.
1600–2500 rating: Ranked AI becomes available after 5 minutes.
2501+ rating: Ranked AI becomes available after 10 minutes.
Eligible human opponents always have priority.
Ranked AI opponents display an AI tag.
Ranked AI matches count toward rating, statistics, and match history.
Fixed duel clocks remaining assigned to the AI after certain prompts.
New replays display recorded duel times alongside player names and Z-Move gauges.
Older replays without recorded clocks display --:--.
⚙️ PERFORMANCE & RELIABILITY
Improved team list loading and Pokémon preview loading.
Improved online match stability and connection handling.
Improved Ranked matchmaking, cancellation, and disconnect handling.
Improved updater reliability and progress feedback.

entries.title: Z Start of a New Era
changes: ⚡ Z-MOVES
Z-Moves are now available to all players.
Added Z-Move gauges to the redesigned player banners.
Z-Moves are fully supported during online matches.
⚔️ NEW BATTLE SCREEN
Completely redesigned the Battle Screen with larger Pokémon figures and bigger, easier-to-read wheels.
Improved Player 1 and Player 2 blue/red visual identities.
Player names, duel timers, and Z-Move gauges are now displayed together in the top banners.
Added a centered Weather banner showing the current weather and its description.
Expanded move panels to display move names, damage or stars, and full effect descriptions.
Added ACTIVE EFFECTS sections showing statuses, markers, passive Plates, and supported field or trainer effects.
Added visible names and descriptions for status effects including Asleep, Cracked, Curse, and Photon.
Enlarged wheel status icons and added new battle visuals for effects such as Burn and Frozen.
Improved wheel, VS emblem, and battle information positioning.
🎮 BOARD & UI
Refreshed player banners, timers, buttons, and Z-Move gauges with stronger blue/red visuals.
Added animated turn indicator arrows.
End Turn now draws attention when no actions remain or when the player has been inactive for one minute.
Updated the Plate buttons with the generic Plate logo.
Redesigned Gym Leader and Elite Four introductions.
Added a new Champion introduction.
Restored the previous Player Hub layout while keeping the Poké Ball Match History background.
Rounded the Player Hub top banner.
👥 TEAM BUILDER
Significantly improved saved-team loading speed and memory usage.
Team previews now load more efficiently.
Improved Team Builder navigation when backing out of menus.
Ranked team validation continues to check ownership and Mega Evolution restrictions.
⚙️ GAMEPLAY CHANGES
When no Pokémon can move, a legally usable Plate must now be played before ending the turn.
Each Pokémon can now have a maximum of one Mega Evolution attached, including Charizard X/Y and Mewtwo X/Y.
Repeated-hit moves such as Fire Spin now stop after a maximum of 10 actual spins, including the initial spin. Ability bonus hits can still occur in addition to these spins.
Successful form changes now clear markers and their associated effects while preserving Wait.
🐛 FIGURE & BATTLE FIXES
Aegislash now correctly returns from Blade Form to Shield Form when leaving the field, including temporary and permanent exclusion.
Defensive knockout-prevention effects now correctly work when attacked from two spaces away.
Fixed Larvesta and Fire Scales incorrectly burning protected attackers from two spaces away.
Eevee can now correctly receive its evolution opportunity when a defeated opponent uses a form change to avoid its normal knockout destination.
Arceus's entry ability now activates when entering the field through effects such as Pokémon Switch, but not when simply swapping between field spaces.
Regirock, Regice, and Registeel now affect all opposing Pokémon within two steps, with each affected Pokémon resolving its own spin.
Surrounded Cracked Pokémon are now permanently excluded instead of being sent to Ultra Space.
Fixed Kyogre's Tidal Wave when affecting adjacent Pokémon.
🏆 RANKED AI OPPONENTS
Ranked matchmaking can now provide an AI opponent when an eligible human opponent cannot be found.
Below 1600 rating, AI opponents can appear after 20 seconds.
From 1600 to 2500 rating, AI opponents can appear after 5 minutes.
Above 2500 rating, AI opponents can appear after 10 minutes.
Eligible human opponents always have priority over AI opponents.
Ranked AI uses randomized legal EX/UX teams and Ranked-legal Plates.
AI trainers have generated trainer-style usernames with an AI tag.
Matches against Ranked AI affect rating, statistics, and Match History just like regular Ranked matches.
🌐 ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Improved overall online battle stability.
Reduced the chance of battle actions being lost during busy moments.
Improved online performance during large bursts of battle activity, especially on Android.
Improved match setup, disconnect, cancellation, and result handling.
Match results can retry uploading after temporary connection problems or restarting the game.
A new Ranked search cannot begin while the previous Ranked result is still being processed.
🔄 UPDATER
Improved overall updater reliability.
Downloads can now resume when supported instead of always restarting from the beginning.
Added automatic recovery for interrupted or stalled downloads.
Reduced freezing during large update installations.
Improved Windows update installation and recovery.
Improved protection against corrupted update downloads.
Account data, saved teams, and Match History are preserved during updater recovery.
Improved progress information while downloading, verifying, and installing updates.
📜 PATCH NOTES
Players must be on the updated game version to play online together with the new v0.8.8 gameplay rules.
Welcome to the Z era!

entries.title: Sandbox Mode, Match History Overhaul & Battle Fixes
changes: 🧪 NEW: SANDBOX MODE
Added a new Sandbox Mode under Offline.
Sandbox Mode is always local Player vs Player and is designed for testing Pokémon, moves, abilities and unusual battle situations.
Press F12 during a Sandbox match to open or close the Debug Tool.
A Sandbox indicator is displayed at the bottom of the battle screen.
Match clocks are disabled in Sandbox Mode.
Sandbox matches are not added to Match History.
In official release builds, the Debug Tool is strictly limited to Sandbox Mode and cannot be opened in Ranked, Online, Campaign, normal Offline matches or Replays.
🛠️ SANDBOX DEBUG TOOL
Added dedicated Debug Tool pages for Figure State, Battle & Spins, and Sandbox Controls.
The Debug Tool can apply and remove Special Conditions.
The Debug Tool can add or clear Wait and markers.
The Debug Tool can force specific battle-wheel results.
The Debug Tool can initiate battles and manually KO or exclude Pokémon.
Sandbox Controls can target Pokémon on the field, Bench, P.C., Ultra Space or Excluded area.
Added Previous Turn, which restores the duel to the beginning of the previous turn.
Added controls to manually Evolve eligible Pokémon.
Added controls to Revive Pokémon and return them to the Bench.
Added controls to send Pokémon directly to the P.C. or Ultra Space.
Improved the Debug Tool layout and removed unnecessary horizontal scrolling.
🕘 MATCH HISTORY OVERHAUL
Completely redesigned the Match History screen with a cleaner duel-focused layout.
Added dedicated My Matches, Online, Offline and Global tabs.
Only the match list on the left now scrolls while Match Details remain fixed and visible.
Added improved search and match-type filtering.
Improved Win, Loss, Draw and Abandoned indicators.
Selecting a match now displays both players more prominently.
Winners are highlighted in green and losers in red.
Improved Local PvP result clarity.
Added full team previews when lineup information is available.
Team figures can be hovered or selected to inspect their Pokémon card information.
Figure previews now show the Pokémon's rarity, type and MP beside its name.
Improved Ability and Move presentation in Match Details.
Improved alignment and centering of figure icons.
Added new Match History menu icons and improved navigation styling.
Old matches without saved lineup information now clearly show that team data is unavailable instead of displaying incorrect information.
⚔️ BATTLE & ABILITY FIXES
Fixed Houndour – Infernal Hunt failing to activate on equal Purple vs Purple results.
Houndour and its battle opponent are now burned regardless of the battle outcome when Infernal Hunt applies.
Fixed Houndoom – Malevolent Fire spreading Burn when Houndoom only became Burned during that same battle.
Houndoom must now already be Burned before the battle begins to spread Burn to its opponent.
Pokémon now correctly retain Wait after being knocked out and entering the P.C.
Pokémon can also have Wait while already in the P.C.
Fixed Torracat – Playful Punch knockback pathing so the opponent can correctly be pushed along applicable diagonal board paths.
Playful Punch now correctly activates on a draw or loss.
Fixed Torracat – Fire Bell sometimes failing to Burn nearby Grass-type Pokémon when Torracat is knocked out.
Fixed Incineroar – Suplex only working when a perfectly straight space was available behind Incineroar.
Suplex now considers all appropriate spaces behind Incineroar and allows the player to choose a destination when multiple spaces are available.
Fixed Overheat's temporary Miss effect not displaying correctly on the wheel.
Overheat now becomes Miss for one turn only.
Landing on the temporary Miss no longer causes Overheat to remain Miss again on the following turn.
Fixed Entei being unable to move past Burned Pokémon when entering the field from the Bench.
Fixed Heatran – Magma Slide automatically choosing a destination instead of presenting available options.
Magma Slide is no longer restricted to movement in a single straight-line direction.
Fixed Heatran being able to make an additional normal MP move after activating its Bench battle ability.
Fixed Monferno – Mid-Air Strike not knocking the battle opponent back 1 step on a draw or loss.
Mid-Air Strike now lets the player choose the destination when multiple valid spaces are available.
Fixed Infernape – Detect failing to grant +1 MP on Infernape's next turn.
Fixed Weak Spot Kick not correctly applying Wait 4 on both wins and losses when applicable.
🔥 DELPHOX & FLAME GUN FIXES
Fixed Delphox – Flame Kinesis moving Pokémon 3 steps away from their own starting position instead of 3 steps away from Delphox.
Flame Kinesis now considers valid destinations in every applicable direction.
Fixed Delphox – Magic Trick failing to restore a used Plate when Delphox was excluded after landing Miss.
Updated Flame Gun for Magmortar and Celesteela to: "The battle opponent and one Pokémon adjacent to it are knocked out."
The Flame Gun user can now choose the additional adjacent Pokémon.
The additional Flame Gun target may be either an opposing or allied Pokémon.
The Pokémon using Flame Gun cannot select itself as the additional target.
🐉 MEGA EVOLUTION FIXES
Mega Evolution countdowns now continue decreasing while the Mega-Evolved Pokémon is in Ultra Space.
Fixed Mega Charizard X – Backdraft knockouts so its ability can correctly exclude the defeated Pokémon for 7 turns.
Backdraft's loss effect continues to send the opponent to the P.C. as intended.
Fixed Mega Charizard Y's surround ability failing to activate when Mega Charizard Y participated in the surround but did not complete it.
🖥️ ADDITIONAL UI FIXES
Fixed the Duel Log appearing underneath the Duel Complete menu.
Improved several Match History spacing, button and card-layout issues.
Improved readability of long status labels such as Abandoned.

entries.title: Move, Ability & Mega Evolution Fixes
changes: ⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Fixed Delphox – Flame Kinesis moving Pokémon 3 steps away from their original position instead of 3 steps away from Delphox.
Flame Kinesis now considers all valid destinations around Delphox, including positions behind it.
Fixed Delphox – Magic Trick failing to restore a used Plate when Delphox was excluded after landing Miss.
Fixed Weak Spot Kick not correctly applying Wait 4 on both wins and losses when the affected Pokémon remains on the field.
Fixed Monferno – Mid-Air Strike not knocking the battle opponent back 1 step on a draw or loss.
Mid-Air Strike now allows the player to choose the destination when multiple valid spaces are available.
Fixed Infernape – Detect failing to grant +1 MP on Infernape's next turn.
Fixed Entei being unable to move past Burned Pokémon while entering the field from the Bench.
Fixed Heatran – Magma Slide automatically pushing Pokémon instead of allowing the player to choose from valid destinations.
Magma Slide can now move Pokémon along valid paths in different directions instead of only along a straight line.
Fixed Heatran being able to make an additional MP move after using its Bench ability. Heatran must now proceed directly to the battle initiated by the ability.
🔥 TORRACAT & INCINEROAR
Fixed Torracat – Playful Punch not pushing the battle opponent to the farthest available point in a straight line.
Playful Punch now activates correctly on a draw or loss.
Fixed Torracat's Fire Bell ability failing to Burn Grass-type Pokémon within 2 steps when Torracat is knocked out.
Fixed Incineroar – Suplex only working when a space was available directly behind Incineroar in a straight line.
Suplex now considers all valid spaces behind Incineroar and allows the player to choose a destination when multiple options are available.
🔥 FLAME GUN
Updated Flame Gun for Magmortar and Celesteela to: "The battle opponent and one Pokémon adjacent to it are knocked out."
The Flame Gun user can now choose which Pokémon adjacent to the battle opponent is also knocked out.
The additional target may be either an opposing Pokémon or one of the user's own Pokémon.
The Pokémon using Flame Gun cannot select itself as the additional target.
🐉 MEGA EVOLUTION FIXES
Mega Evolution countdowns now continue decreasing while a Mega-Evolved Pokémon is in Ultra Space.
Fixed Mega Charizard X – Backdraft so Pokémon it knocks out can correctly be excluded for 7 turns by its ability.
If Mega Charizard X loses while using Backdraft, the battle opponent is still sent to the P.C. as intended.
Fixed Mega Charizard Y's ability failing to activate when it participated in a surround without being the Pokémon that completed the surround.
A Pokémon surrounded with Mega Charizard Y participating is now correctly sent to Mega Charizard Y's P.C.
🖥️ INTERFACE FIXES
Fixed the Duel Log appearing underneath the Duel Complete menu.
The Duel Log can now be viewed correctly from the end-of-match screen.

entries.title: Match History, Ranked Stability & Battle Fixes
changes: 🕘 MATCH HISTORY
Replaced Recent Matches in the Hub with a new MATCH HISTORY menu.
Match History now includes My Matches and Global Match History.
My Matches displays Offline and Online match history in separate sections.
Global Match History displays recent Ranked matches from all players and supports player search.
Moved Global Match History out of the Ranked menu.
When leaving a replay, you can now return to the replay list you came from or return to the main Match History menu.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Fixed Marshadow's Gloomdweller affecting the wrong figures. Only Ghost-type Pokémon belonging to Marshadow's own team are now considered.
Fixed knockout-triggered status effects such as Ice Beam and Ice Punch when the user is excluded instead of sent to the P.C. Their status effect can still activate as intended.
Fixed Rhyperior's Reckless Charge preventing MP reductions from working properly.
MP-reducing effects can now correctly reduce Rhyperior's normal movement while Reckless Charge remains available as an optional movement ability.
Fixed Force Remove excluding Pokémon defeated by being surrounded. Surround knockouts now send the Pokémon to the P.C. normally.
Fixed Brutal Swing not allowing the appropriate player to choose where affected Pokémon are moved.
Fixed Aerodactyl EX and Mega Aerodactyl's Sky Drop incorrectly giving Wait 5 to Flying-type battle opponents.
Fixed Psychock failing to knock out Frozen Pokémon.
Fixed Vaporeon UX's Water Slide automatically choosing a movement destination instead of allowing the appropriate player to choose.
Fixed UX Eeveelutions being unable to use their movement abilities to pass through your own Pokémon blocking Entry Points.
Fixed Bewear's Wave Arms sending the battle opponent to the Bench when Bewear won the battle. Its movement effect now resolves only when appropriate instead of replacing a normal knockout.
Fixed Balloon Flight remaining active after the user's next battle when the user was knocked out.
Fixed Torterra's Ability not allowing your Pokémon to pass through Torterra when entering the field.
Fixed Aurora Beam not resolving correctly during equal-star Purple Attack ties.
Fixed Garchomp and Mega Garchomp's Double Flight sometimes automatically selecting a landing point instead of allowing the player to choose.
Fixed Double Flight allowing too many consecutive additional attacks.
Fixed Kangaskhan being knocked out by its own Purple Attack when battling a Ghost-type Pokémon while Scrappy's protection should apply.
Kangaskhan's Scrappy now correctly recognizes dual-type Ghost Pokémon such as Doublade.
Fixed Pokémon that cannot be moved by opposing effects still being affected by moves such as Judgment, Sunsteel Strike and Blade Tail.
Moves that send the battle opponent directly to the P.C. instead of knocking it out now correctly respect immunity to opposing movement effects.
Fixed Sylveon's Fairy Wind not correctly recognizing Pokémon that gained the Dragon type during the duel, such as Arceus.
Fixed Landorus being unable to change Forme with Elusive Master when its alternate Forme was equipped in the team.
Fixed Ice Shard not making the appropriate opposing Pokémon within 2 steps spin.
Ice Shard now still activates after its user is knocked out by a White or Gold Attack.
Field spin effects now resolve after the battle knockout has been processed instead of before it.
Fixed Rockstorm applying its secondary effect before resolving the battle opponent's knockout.
Rockstorm now resolves the battle opponent's knockout first, then sends adjacent Fire-type and Flying-type Pokémon to the P.C.
Fixed Tapu Fini's Misty Surge protecting Pokémon from Special Conditions during the opponent's turn.
Misty Surge's Special Condition protection now applies only during Tapu Fini's owner's turn, protecting both players' Pokémon within 2 steps during that turn.
Fixed Trickery still allowing a wheel shift after Cracked converted its segment into a Miss.
Fixed MP markers being calculated before other movement modifiers.
Positive and negative MP markers are now applied last when calculating a Pokémon's final movement, preventing movement bonuses from incorrectly overriding negative MP markers.
🌐 RANKED
Improved recovery when a Ranked match gets stuck during PLAYER FOUND.
If the opponent fails to finish connecting, the matchmaking attempt will now cancel instead of leaving the player stuck indefinitely.
Improved Ranked matchmaking after restarting the game following an interrupted match.
Reduced cases where players could repeatedly fail to re-enter the Ranked queue after a connection issue.
↩️ MENU NAVIGATION
Improved Back button navigation throughout the game.
Back now returns to the previous menu instead of unnecessarily returning directly to the Account Hub.
Improved navigation between Play, Offline, Online Multiplayer, LAN, and Custom Online matches.
🖥️ WINDOW FIXES
Fixed an issue where returning through menus could cause the game window to unexpectedly leave its maximized state.
Maximized windows should now remain maximized while navigating through menus.

entries.title: Recent Fixes & Improvements
changes: This update adds new figure filtering options and includes several recent gameplay, leaderboard, and replay fixes.
🔎 FIGURE FILTERING & SORTING
Added Figure ID filtering to Team Builder, Figure Library, and Figure Collection.
You can now search directly by Figure ID using values such as 331 or #331.
Figure ID is handled separately from National Pokédex number.
Added Figure ID Low → High and Figure ID High → Low sorting options.
Pokédex number sorting remains available separately.
🏆 LEADERBOARD
Improved Full Leaderboard loading so all Ranked players can be loaded across multiple pages.
Fixed older Ranked players potentially being missing because historical Ranked games were not included in their Ranked game count.
Leaderboard columns now display WIN, LOSS, and DRAW.
Removed unnecessary decimal values from Rating and match statistics.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Trickery Shift now occurs after applicable damage buffs and debuffs have been calculated, allowing players to see the correct final attack values before making their decision.
Force Remove now properly excludes a defeated figure instead of allowing knockout-triggered form changes or similar effects to bypass it.
Purple vs Purple ties no longer activate battle passives.
Fixed Mirror Coat and similar effects incorrectly activating after a Purple vs Purple draw.
Pokémon with effects that activate when knocked out during battle no longer trigger those effects when they are knocked out by unrelated field or secondary effects.
Fixed exclusion effects such as Fusion Flare and Fusion Bolt not properly excluding a Pokémon when another battle effect such as Destiny Bond was involved.
🌀 MOVE & ABILITY FIXES
Corrected Warp Hole so the battle opponent can be swapped only with another Pokémon belonging to the opponent from the field, Bench, or P.C.
Corrected Tractor so Swampert can move to any available adjacent point before the opposing Pokémon moves onto Swampert's previous point.
Mud Coating no longer stacks between multiple regular Swampert.
Swampert and Mega Swampert can still have their separate Mud Coating effects combine.
Dragon Sphere now checks the Pokémon's effective MP after other MP modifiers and only grants +1 MP when the Pokémon is still MP1.
Fixed Aegislash form changes preventing the player from ending their turn.
🎥 REPLAY FIXES
Improved replay synchronization when using Previous Turn.
Rewinding a replay should no longer cause battles to produce different results and desynchronize the rest of the match.

entries.title: Player profiles, Ranked improvements and additional player-reported fixes.
changes: 👤 PLAYER PROFILES
Added Player Profiles during online duels.
Hover over a player's name on desktop, or tap it on mobile, to view their profile.
Player Profiles can display Favorite Figure, Rank, Rating Points, Ranked Wins, Losses and Draws.
Players can choose to make their account Private.
Private profiles only display the player's username.
Improved Player Profile sizing to remove unnecessary empty space.
⚔️ RANKED HEAD-TO-HEAD STATS
During Ranked matches, opponent profiles now display their Win Rate vs You.
Head-to-head Win Rate only counts completed Ranked matches played between those two accounts.
Draws are included in the total number of head-to-head matches.
💤 RANKED AFK DETECTION
Added inactivity detection to Ranked matches.
If a player performs no activity for 2 minutes during their turn, an Are You Still Here warning appears.
The player then has 60 seconds to confirm they are still present.
Pressing YES completely resets the inactivity timer.
If the countdown reaches 0, the inactive player receives an AFK Loss and their opponent receives the win.
Waiting for the opponent does not count as inactivity.
AFK detection only applies to Ranked matches and does not affect Private Online matches.
🎲 RANDOM TEAM IMPROVEMENTS
Significantly improved Random Team loading performance.
Random Team no longer needs to load the player's entire available figure roster before selecting a team.
This should greatly reduce the long freeze that could occur after pressing Random Team.
📚 MOVE & ABILITY LIBRARY
Added a new Move & Ability Library to the Database.
Moves and Abilities can now be browsed separately from the Figure and Plate Libraries.
Selecting a Move or Ability displays its effect and the figures that have access to it.
Duplicate Moves and Abilities are combined into a single entry.
Improved rarity icon spacing and presentation throughout the library.
🔧 FIGURE PROGRESSION
Continued implementation of Figure Leveling, Wheel Expansion and Chain Levels.
Figure Levels can eventually reach Level 10 and Chain Levels can eventually reach Chain Level 10.
Wheel expansion and wheel redistribution systems have been implemented.
Chain Levels increase eligible Attack damage.
Improved Figure Manager upgrade controls.
Rare Metals and Green Cubes can now be used in adjustable quantities instead of one at a time.
Progression materials are still being introduced gradually and may not yet be obtainable through normal gameplay.
🎥 RANKED REPLAYS
Improved Ranked replay saving.
Replays now save correctly whether the player wins or loses.
Ranked matches ended using Forfeit can now save their replay.
Improved Match History so newly uploaded replays appear correctly.
🐛 PLAYER-REPORTED FIXES
Fixed cases where a player could incorrectly receive a Wait Loss despite still having a legal action available.
Available Plates and other possible actions are now properly considered before determining that a player has no actions remaining.
Fixed Leaf Blade and similar additional-spin Attacks so their original result is preserved correctly.
Fixed Leafeon UX - Blade Tail so its effect can activate correctly when losing against eligible White or Gold Attacks.
Fixed Tapu Fini - Misty Surge movement behavior.
Fixed Avalugg - Ice Breaker being usable more than intended during the same turn.
Fixed the AI using Max Revive when both of its Entry Points were already occupied.
Fixed weather information hover boxes appearing incorrectly stretched the first time they were opened.
🖱️ MENU UI CLEANUP
Removed unnecessary hover boxes from several obvious menu controls.
Settings, Discord, library navigation, Filter, Sort and similar self-explanatory controls no longer display redundant hover descriptions.
Informative tooltips explaining mechanics, restrictions, progression and gameplay rules remain available.
🌐 PRIVATE ONLINE MATCHES
Fixed a menu routing issue where leaving or forfeiting a Private Online match could return the player to the Offline menu.
Private Online matches now return to the appropriate Online and Lobby flow.

entries.title: Figure leveling groundwork and additional player-reported fixes.
changes: ⚙️ FIGURE LEVELING & WHEEL EXPANSION
Development has begun on the backend systems for Figure Leveling and Wheel Expansion.
Figure leveling will eventually allow players to expand selected wheel segments while reducing others.
The materials required to level figures are not currently obtainable, so there is currently no way to level figures.
More details about leveling, materials, and progression will be shared as the system gets closer to release.
🐛 PLAYER-REPORTED FIXES
Fixed an issue where players could incorrectly receive a Wait Loss while still having a legal action available.
Available Plates and other possible actions are now properly considered before determining that a player has no actions remaining.
A Wait Loss should now only occur when the player truly has nothing they can do.
🎮 AI IMPROVEMENTS
Smarter AI ?

entries.title: Match Replays and player-reported gameplay fixes.
changes: 🎬 MATCH REPLAYS
Added Replay support for recent matches. (Starting 0.7.2)
⚔️ GAMEPLAY FIXES
Fixed Empoleon – Diving Entry not working correctly on the opening turn.
Fixed Swords Dance stacking its multiplier multiple times. Spinning Swords Dance repeatedly now still results in a maximum ×2 damage multiplier.
Fixed Dragon Tail effects not resolving correctly when losing against eligible White or Gold Attacks.
Fixed 4-D Drive effects not resolving correctly when losing against eligible White or Gold Attacks.
Fixed Sunsteel Strike not sending the opposing Pokémon to the P.C. when its effect should activate against White or Gold results.
Fixed Abyssal Grip sending the wrong Pokémon to the P.C.
Fixed Heracross – Mud Shot not applying its intended MP −1 effect.
Fixed Avalugg effects incorrectly applying while Avalugg was on the Bench instead of requiring it to be on the field.
Fixed qualifying knockouts sometimes failing to trigger the appropriate Evolution opportunity.
💿 PLATE FIXES
Fixed Eon Flute sometimes being unavailable when an excluded Latias or Latios was a valid target.
Separated Mega Evolution Plates into their own category in the Plate Library filters.
🔄 POSITION-SWAPPING FIXES
Fixed the Volt Switch choice prompt displaying the wrong effect name.
Fixed Volt Switch when switching with a Pokémon from the P.C. The Volt Switch user now correctly goes to the P.C. instead of the Bench.
Fixed Gardevoir – Warp Hole when selecting a Pokémon from the P.C. The Pokémon being replaced now correctly goes to the P.C. instead of the Bench.

entries.title: Mobile improvements, library updates and form fixes.
changes: 🗺️ NEW CONTENT
Added a special new map with its own unique presentation and features.
Added new special options to the Settings menu for additional customization.
🗺️ MAP & VISUAL FIXES
Fixed several effects on the Original Map appearing underneath the board on the opponent's side.
Fixed Plate activation effects and battle wheel animations being hidden beneath the Original Map.
Restored Entry Point and Goal icons to their proper board-level position.
Improved rendering of the Original Map so effects display consistently on both sides of the board.
⚔️ BATTLE FIXES
Fixed White and Gold moves with equal final damage not activating their effects correctly.
Fixed Sacred Fire not correctly burning the battle opponent.
Fixed certain move-effect indicators not displaying correctly in figure previews.
Fixed Pokémon attacking from 2 or more spaces away being affected by opposing Attack effects that should not reach them.
Fixed effects such as Grass Knot incorrectly knocking out a Pokémon attacking from Range 2+.
Fixed Force Remove not properly excluding defeated Pokémon.
Force Remove now activates before knockout-related form changes and prevents those transformations when the Pokémon is being excluded.
Knockouts caused by attacks such as Destiny Bond and Double-Edge can once again trigger appropriate evolution, devolution, or form-change effects.
Pokémon sent specifically to the Bench, P.C., or Excluded by a move do not receive knockout-based form-change protection.
Pokémon now recover from Special Conditions when changing form.
Damage increases and reductions are now applied before Double Chance and similar respin prompts.
If a respin occurs, all applicable damage buffs and reductions are recalculated for the new Attack.
Fixed Mega Ampharos – Homeward Lights failing to properly activate a second time when Mega Evolution ends.
Fixed Alolan Raichu – Cosmic Surfer displaying invalid movement destinations.
Fixed Cosmic Surfer accidentally treating Alolan Raichu itself as part of its Electric Pokémon chain.
Fixed Mawile – Trickery so shifting the wheel is optional as intended.
Trickery now asks the player whether they want to shift the result when it lands.
Fixed Trickery activating when both Pokémon landed Blue Attacks.
Trickery now waits for the opposing Attack's effects to resolve before offering its wheel-shift choice.
Fixed Bergmite – Ice Scramble incorrectly protecting Bergmite itself from being tagged while Frozen.
Fixed Arcanine – Flame Turbine potentially shifting the opponent's wheel repeatedly.
Fixed Eevee UX – Bright Arrow interacting incorrectly with Air Balloon. Air Balloon no longer overrides Eevee UX's 3 MP rule while still providing its pass-over movement effect.
Fixed Shadow Ball so its secondary wheel-spin effect resolves correctly.
Fixed Sweet Scent so Wait is only applied when the forced movement successfully occurs.
Fixed Ultra Burst sometimes activating without transforming Necrozma.
Fixed Destiny Bond incorrectly triggering when a Pokémon was knocked out by being surrounded after effects such as Pheromosa – Call Signal.
Fixed Garchomp – Double Flight allowing repeated additional attacks. It can now grant only one extra attack per attack chain.
Fixed Dragon Tail so winning with Dragon Tail knocks out the opponent normally and sends it to the P.C.
Fixed Dragon Tail so its Bench and Wait effect occurs when Dragon Tail loses, as intended.
Fixed Mega Glalie – Icy Armor potentially creating a phantom knockout or visual desync during online matches.
Updated Regice – Lock-On wording to correctly specify one opposing Pokémon within 2 steps.
Improved handling of effects that state "The battle opponent becomes...".
Effects such as Chandelure's Inferno can now affect the battle opponent even if the move user loses or ties, provided the opposing Attack is White, Gold, or Miss.
"The battle opponent becomes..." effects do not activate against Blue or Purple Attacks.
Improved several battle-effect timing rules involving Attack colors, ties, and passive effects.
When a Pokémon manually changes form through an Ability or Attack, that Pokémon must now be used for the remainder of the turn.
Form changes caused by Plates also commit the player to that Pokémon if they continue acting, but the player may still choose to End Turn.
Abilities that explicitly end the turn after transforming continue to do so normally.
Improved several knockout and form-change interactions.
💿 PLATE FIXES
Fixed Restorer failing to properly recognize Amaura as a Restored Pokémon.
Fixed Winged Sphere failing to allow eligible evolved Bug/Flying Pokémon such as Butterfree to move over opposing non-Flying Pokémon.
Improved Stage 1+ detection for Plate effects.
Sphere Plate effects are now indicated on the Pokémon card of affected Pokémon.
Improved Sphere Plate passive information shown on affected Pokémon cards.
Gold Sphere now correctly recognizes Mega Evolution as an Evolution.
Eligible Mega-Evolved Ground-type Pokémon can now have their White Attacks become Gold during their first battle after entering the field, as intended.
✨ FORM CHANGE PERFORMANCE
Significantly reduced the freeze that could occur when activating Ultra Burst.
Form-changing Plates now search only the relevant Pokémon resources instead of unnecessarily loading the entire figure library.
Added a new Form Attachment system that prepares required Pokémon forms during team and match setup.
Form-changing Abilities and Plates can now use already-loaded form data instead of searching for forms during the duel.
Ultra Necrozma is now prepared before the duel when Ultra Burst is equipped on a compatible team.
Improved form-change loading and performance across multiple Pokémon and Plates.
✨ NEW FORM SYSTEM
Added optional form attachments to Team Builder.
Players can choose whether certain optional forms are available to their Pokémon during battle.
Currently supported optional form choices include Giratina, Keldeo, and Zygarde.
Forms required by a Pokémon's core mechanics, Ability, or Plate are attached automatically when needed.
Automatic form support includes systems such as Aegislash, Necrozma, Kyurem, Shaymin, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Therian Formes, and Rotom forms.
Optional form selections are saved with the team and persist after restarting the game.
Form changes now use a visible transformation sequence similar to Evolution.
Forward form changes play the Evolution sound.
Returning to a base or lower form plays the Devolution sound.
Form-changing Plates now wait for the visible transformation to finish before returning control to the player.
Improved support for automatic form changes that do not need to be manually selected in Team Builder.
Improved automatic form handling for Pokémon such as Aegislash, Rotom, White Kyurem, Black Kyurem, Necrozma, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, and other automatically-attached forms.
Fixed automatic form detection for Pokémon whose form name appears before the species name, such as Wash Rotom and White Kyurem.
Automatic forms required by Evolutions, Abilities, and Plates are now prepared before battle more consistently.
Improved King's Shield and Aegislash's Shield and Blade Forme switching.
Improved automatic form reversion for Kyurem, Rotom, Necrozma, and other form-changing Pokémon.
Form transformations now consistently use the shared transformation animation and Evolution/Devolution sound system.
🏆 RANKED MATCH FIXES
Improved Ranked stability when a player unexpectedly closes the game or disconnects.
When an opponent disconnects during an active Ranked duel, the match now pauses and gives them 60 seconds to reconnect.
A visible reconnect countdown is displayed to the remaining player.
If the disconnected player does not return, they receive the loss and the connected player receives the win.
Players can now search for and reconnect to an unfinished Ranked match after reopening the game.
Added additional safeguards preventing the player who remained connected from accidentally receiving the loss.
Main Menu and Quit Game are disabled during an active Ranked match; players must explicitly use Forfeit Match.
Fixed opponents leaving after MATCH OVER incorrectly starting another reconnect countdown.
Fixed Ranked matches becoming stuck indefinitely on Finalizing Ranked Result.
Improved protection against disconnect events changing a result that had already been determined.
Improved Ranked matchmaking reliability when many players are searching simultaneously.
Fixed cases where players could receive Too Many Requests while searching for Ranked matches.
Fixed Zoroark's Cross Counter incorrectly knocking out Pokémon that should not be affected.
Fixed Thundurus's ability not correctly preventing opposing Pokémon that MP moved next to it that turn from attacking.
Fixed Eevee's evolution selection becoming stuck after knocking out a Pokémon and triggering an evolution choice.
📈 RANKED RATING
Ranked wins now award a minimum of +20 RP.
Ranked losses now remove a maximum of 15 RP.
Draws now always result in 0 RP gained or lost.
Elo/rating difference calculations are still used whenever they produce values within those limits.
👤 RANKED PLAYER INFORMATION
Recent Ranked Matches now show the opponent's Rank Points.
Hovering a recent opponent now displays their player profile.
Player profiles include useful Ranked information such as rank, rating, W/L/D, and favorite Pokémon.
Opponent Rank Points are now displayed underneath their username during Ranked battles.
Online turn indicators and Plate passive displays now use player usernames instead of Player 1 / Player 2.
Online turn indicators now display YOUR TURN and OPPONENT'S TURN where appropriate.
Offline matches continue using Player 1 / Player 2.
🌐 ONLINE & MATCH IMPROVEMENTS
The Duel Complete screen now displays the reason the duel ended.
Added clearer match-end messages for Goal wins, Time Loss, Wait Loss, forfeits, disconnects, lost connections, match dodges, players leaving the match, and Turn Limit results.
🤖 AI IMPROVEMENTS
Improved AI decision-making during battles.
Added additional checks for Pokémon abilities and movement effects when evaluating threats and defensive positions.
Restored the faster AI turn pacing used in earlier versions of the game.
Optimized rush-team and pass-through Ability evaluation so complex movement checks no longer unnecessarily slow down AI turns.
The AI still accounts for important movement Abilities and defensive matchups without repeatedly recalculating them during every simulated path.
Improved AI responsiveness during Offline matches.
The AI now avoids choosing an optional respin when its current Attack is already winning.
If the AI is losing or tied, it may still choose to respin when appropriate.
The AI also avoids voluntarily forcing an unnecessary respin when doing so would give up an already-winning result.
🎮 UI & QUALITY OF LIFE
Added an EXCLUDED viewer above Ultra Space.
Excluded Pokémon are displayed as their actual figures, similar to Ultra Space.
The Excluded viewer safely handles matches where no Pokémon have been excluded.
Hovering Pokémon in the Team Builder now displays their full Pokémon card.
Added a visual FORM option to compatible Pokémon in Team Builder.
Optional forms are displayed using visual cards with the Pokémon's figure, name, rarity, MP, and Attach / Remove option.
Hovering an optional form displays its full Pokémon information card.
Hovering attached Evolution or Form options underneath a selected Pokémon displays the corresponding Pokémon card.
When a YES/NO prompt would evolve, devolve, or change a Pokémon's form, hovering YES now previews the Pokémon it will become.
Pokémon card previews now appear on the opposite side of form and transformation prompts so they do not cover the player's choice.
Pokémon forms are now visible in the Figure Library, even when they cannot be directly added to a team.
Battle-only and automatic forms can now be viewed in Team Builder.
Forms that cannot be selected as one of the six team figures are clearly marked as unavailable for direct addition.
Forms automatically granted by a Plate now indicate which Plate is required.
Automatic form information tooltips are kept inside the screen so they remain readable near the edges of the viewport.
When the required Plate is equipped, its associated form is displayed in that Pokémon's FORM viewer.
Plate-granted forms are shown as automatic and locked attachments and cannot be manually removed.
Removing the required Plate removes its automatic form attachment.
Intrinsic forms such as Aegislash's Shield and Blade Formes are always available in its form viewer.
Optional forms such as Giratina, Keldeo, and Zygarde continue using their normal Attach / Remove controls.
Improved Pokémon form previews and hover-card information throughout Team Builder.
Added a Fullscreen option for desktop players.
Added Streamer Mode to Settings, which hides the team name while searching in online matchmaking.
Fixed excessive empty spacing in the Plate Library preview panel.
Improved several Pokémon card hover displays and information panels.
Various additional UI improvements and fixes based on recently reported issues.
📱 MOBILE IMPROVEMENTS
Reworked Pokémon card interaction for touchscreen devices.
Tapping a Pokémon on mobile now performs the normal gameplay action with a single tap while also opening its Pokémon card for inspection.
Pokémon cards remain open while interacting with them instead of behaving like desktop hover cards.
Players can now touch and drag directly on a Pokémon card to scroll through its information.
Dragging upward on the card scrolls downward through its contents, with normal touch-style scrolling behavior.
Touching or scrolling inside the Pokémon card no longer closes it or activates the board underneath it.
Tapping another Pokémon switches the displayed Pokémon card.
Tapping outside the Pokémon card closes it.
Restored the Pokémon card to its familiar battle-screen position on mobile.
Mobile card sizing adapts when necessary for smaller displays.
Desktop Pokémon card hover behavior remains unchanged.
Added the same touchscreen behavior in preparation for future iOS support.
🍎 macOS IMPROVEMENTS
Improved scrolling support for macOS trackpads.
Added two-finger trackpad scrolling support to several scrollable menus and Pokémon information cards.
Cleaned up a Figure Library 3D viewer camera warning that could appear when opening a model preview.
🩺 STATUS & MARKER INFORMATION
Pokémon cards now show active Special Conditions and markers.
Hovering an affected Pokémon now explains what its current conditions actually do.
Added information for Burn, Poison, Noxious, Paralysis, Sleep, Frozen, and Confusion.
Added information for numerous gameplay markers and temporary effects.
Countdown-based effects display their remaining duration directly on the Pokémon card.
Status and marker information updates while the card remains open.
👤 ACCOUNT IMPROVEMENTS
Users can now log in using their email address instead of only their username.
Users can now change their username.
Usernames now support special characters.
🎵 AUDIO & SETTINGS
Reworked the menu music selector to behave more consistently on Android.
The menu music dropdown now uses the same custom dropdown style as the in-battle selector.
Fixed an Android crash when changing the menu music.
Improved Android handling when switching between Pokémon Duel Remake and Original menu music.
Improved consistency between the Settings menu and battle Settings UI.
📱 ANDROID UPDATE STABILITY
Improved Android stability while downloading game updates.
Reduced conflicting background network activity while update packages are being downloaded or verified.
Prevented additional update checks from interfering with an update already in progress.
🐛 ADDITIONAL FIXES
Fixed several UI elements remaining active or displaying incorrect information after Ranked matches.
Improved handling of form changes, knockout replacements, movement abilities, and Plate effects.
Improved automatic form preparation for Pokémon that evolve or transform after the duel has already started.
Improved handling of form changes triggered by Abilities, Attacks, Plates, Evolutions, and automatic transformations.
Improved several interactions between form changes and turn-action restrictions.
Improved touch input handling so Pokémon information can be viewed without interfering with normal battle controls.
Various additional stability, bug fixes, and interface improvements based on player reports.
